scientific_integrity: The exact independent-increment distribution and moment formulas are explicitly credited to Stark. All three asymptotic regimes are supported by analytic derivations with finite exact and numerical diagnostic replay; no computer experiment is treated as proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform sampling and canonical Knuth cycle statistic only; c>0, beta>1 fixed; beta<=1, nonunit cycle weight, functional-digraph cycles and multivariate cycle lengths excluded. Independent historical priority and mathematical audit outstanding.
title: The square-exponential transition for Knuth cycle counts of multiset permutations
